_description: Ladder-only goals for tests/load/ladder.mjs, merged over the integrity zeros of thresholds.json and the plan goals of thresholds.goals.json (accept p95 <= 200 ms = max_steady_create_p95_ms, read p95 <= 100 ms = max_steady_read_p95_ms, memory headroom >= 20 %, zero OOM kills, voice relay p95 <= 100 ms). Under --require-goals every unmeasured goal FAILS.
_overload_note: max_overload_rate_pct is a harness choice, not a plan number: a step that needed admission refusals (429/503) did not sustain N clients, so the default is 0. Raise it only to study graceful degradation.
_integrity_note: duplicate committed results = duplicate result bodies + duplicate terminal events + one job id returned for two idempotency keys. False-successful truncation = a completed job whose result is a proper prefix of the expected echo, or (with --truncation-probes) a deadline-cut synthetic stream reported completed; it is only measured for the mock and synthetic_chat targets.
